component.name: GNOME-Sign
component.summary: Sign PDF documents with digital certificates
Firma documentos PDF con certificados digitales
Assine documentos PDF com certificados digitais

description.p: GnomeSign is a simple application for signing PDF files using PKCS#12 digital certificates.
GnomeSign es una aplicación sencilla para firmar ficheros PDF utilizando certificados digitales en formato PKCS#12.
O GNOME-Sign é uma aplicação simples para assinar ficheiros PDF com certificados digitais PKCS#12.

ul.li: Signature validation, text search and page thumbnails no longer block the interface on large documents.
Search waits for you to stop typing and cancels outdated queries.
The signature preview is cached instead of being regenerated on every redraw.
Internal restructuring of the signing, validation and search code, with new automated tests.
Fix deleting stamp templates; the active template now falls back safely.
Add missing translations for the stamp editor and printing messages.
Dependencies are now locked from a single source for all package formats.
Security: signature validation no longer fetches data from the network automatically.
Security: Python dependencies are installed with pinned versions and hashes.
Validate signatures against the system trust store.
Fix signature page detection in nested page trees.
